# Several services are degraded

## What Changed

Oct 6, 23:40 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Oct 6, 22:40 UTC Update - We are deploying a mitigation and plan to resume migrations shortly thereafter Oct 6, 21:29 UTC Update - We are working towards a mitigation that will allow us to resume processing enterprise migrations.
